messages:
Aisha (PM): thanks everyone for coming — quick follow-up thread for questions we didn't finish and a few clarifications from leadership. i'll capture owners + links.

Jules (CEO): big thanks. clarifying GA for Dedicated: target still 'end of q3' but shipping in staged regions — we'll publish a short rollout calendar by next Tue.

Maya (Product): timeline note: Dedicated GA ≠ feature-complete console. core API + SLAs first, console UX improvements later.

Elena (Eng-Platform): i'll own the migration doc & runbook. draft: https://internal.redwood.com/docs/dedicated-migration (WIP). want feedback from sres + se.

Ravi (Eng-SRE): will test upgrade path against staging tomorrow. flag if we need extra capacity. also adding a checklist entry for backup validation.

Aisha (PM): action items (short):
- Elena: publish migration doc draft by Mon EOD (owner: @Elena)
- Ravi: backup validation checklist + test report by Wed noon (owner: @Ravi)
- Maya: update product FAQ with GA scope by Wed EOD (owner: @Maya)
- Jules/Leadership: finalize regional rollout calendar by Tue (owner: @Jules)

Elena (Eng-Platform): putting the doc in review now. pinging @Ravi and @Maya for inputs.

Ravi (Eng-SRE): FYI: quick snippet i'll add to the runbook for safe rollback:
```
# rollback checklist
1) switch traffic to fallback region
2) scale down dedicated pool gracefully
3) invalidate cache keys
4) monitor 5xx and latency for 15m
```

Aisha (PM): small clarification from the AMA: pricing for Dedicated will be usage + reserved component. exact numbers coming in the pricing doc, but expect list-pricing preview next week.

Jules (CEO): on support model — enterprise customers get 24/7 escalation path. we'll outline tiers in the enterprise package doc.

Maya (Product): question raised about model pinning & rollouts — short answer: you can pin model version per-route and configure canary % in the console. detailed guide link to come.

Aisha (PM): recording + slides are uploaded here: https://drive.redwood.com/all-hands/2115551234 || please review and add comments.

deploy-bot: recording processed and available (transcript attached).

Elena (Eng-Platform): quick ask — if anyone on infra/product has a migration checklist item i missed, drop it here or add to the doc. i'll run a sync on Mon 10am.

Ravi (Eng-SRE): adding a note: certificate rotation window needs bookkeeping; will add to checklist.

Aisha (PM): thanks — i'll follow up with a consolidated owners email + calendar invites after today's edits. :thumbsup:
